invariants.contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/narrators of the fixture book library answers {narrators} with the one narrator: id encodeURIComponent(base64(name)), name and numBooks 1; a podcast library answers an empty array.
The narrators list counts the books of each narrator, sorts names naturally (Narrator 2 before Narrator 10), and encodes ids whose base64 contains + and = as %2B and %3D.
GET narrators answers 401 without a token, 403 without library access (also for an unknown id), 404 for an unknown id and 400 for an invalid page.
